source_title: The Consumerization of Health Care: How Patients Are Reshaping the Industry
figure_ref: Health Care Consumerization Index by Country (article exhibit; editorial)
business_context: health care consumer experience, cross-market attitudes
key_message: 중국 72점과 일본 36점의 의료소비자화 인식지수 격차는 36점으로, 환자 선택권·편의성 중심의 사업모델은 국가별로 차별화해야 한다.

data_spec.denominator: survey respondents per country, index of six weighted items
data_spec.sample_and_model: n=9,914 in 10 markets; UAE n=354; exact raw responses and item weights not disclosed

data_recipe: Keep reported 0-100 index scores as index points
Derive cross-market gap in index points
Interpret with health-system context and sampling limitations
message_conditions: Same six-item composite index in all markets
Scores do not measure service utilization or patient satisfaction
Country difference is not causal effect or market size
design_moves: highlight the four highest scores as editorial choice
diff_notes: Original exhibit picture not visually opened, so editorial ranked bar from all ten officially reported values; not marked as original reproduction.

training_pair.instruction: Build a reusable 10-market ranked bar of health care consumerization index scores with defensible data provenance and editable themes.
training_pair.response: Files: chart.py with render(data,theme,context)->fig, reported values in data.csv, exact THEME.source/neutral and CONTEXT mappings in config.json. Run python chart.py --data data.csv --config config.json --theme source --output source.png and repeat --theme neutral.
